freshInstall.ifDownloadFails: Recheck the public homepage and manifest URLs, then network connectivity. No GitHub account or private repository access is needed. An update ZIP cannot replace the full installer.

updates.afterFreshInstall: Install the complete 0.2.4 package, then use the in-app update check to upgrade to the current 0.2.18 release. The update reuses the installed models; no manual bridge is required.

completionRequires: Complete app and model verification passes
Installed version matches selected update feed
Unsaved preferences default to rule cleanup, microphone onset protection on, and ribbon animation on; explicitly saved choices are preserved
A real dictation is transcribed and pasted into the target app

When system microphone locking is enabled, verify its device name and active status. Test the actual microphone/headphone combination on the target Mac; do not infer hardware compatibility from package checks.

defaults.appliesWhen: The corresponding preference has not been explicitly saved. Preserve existing saved choices.
defaults.microphoneSelection: Automatic: prefer supported external wired inputs, then built-in input. Bluetooth requires explicit selection on each Mac and follows the microphone onset protection setting.
defaults.systemMicrophoneLock: Opt in separately on each Mac. While FreeJot runs, keep system default input on the selected local microphone, preserving playback across input transitions. Pause input enforcement if restoring playback conflicts with it. Use the Sound Playback picker to recover an already displaced output. This does not block applications that explicitly choose another input.
